newsitem.title: UK: Diploma warns on profits, to hold div.
newsitem.headline: Diploma warns on profits, to hold div.

text.p: Diploma Plc, the UK electronic and building components and scientific laboratory equipment group, warned on Thursday that second half operating profits would be flat on the first half and it would not raise dividends.
"Overall profit performance for the financial year ending September 30, 1997 will fall short of current market forecasts," the group said in a statement.
"We expect to recommended an unchanged final dividend," it added as its shares slumped 58.5p to 256p -- after hitting a new year low of 240p.
Diploma said profits had been hit by price competition and intensifying margin pressures in its principal industrial sectors.

In electronic components, industrial markets continued to bring in lower revenues than last year and Diploma said no sustained trend of manufacturer price rises nor of lengthening lead times was evident.
In the personal computer channel, price competition was intensifying across a broader range of components, it added.
Recent acquisitions in specialist distribution segments continued to perform up to expectations but not sufficiently to outweigh the market effects of its major sectors, the company added.
